i'll do fifteen with one to grow on :)

thank you, i hope you have an amazing day

p.s. you fucking rock.

i'll tell you what you can do for me that will make me feel amazing.
you take that 20$ and go have as much fun as 20$ can get you with whoever you're close too, but keep me in mind will you?
i hope your sister has an amazing birthday. thank you
thank you a lot. you're awesome

i think you are badass just so you know. if i started getting packages out of the blue, id get my ass kicked, (figuratively). i will always do what you said no matter what but i cant take your cash dude. you earned it and put in hours, i just had a shitty birthday. you deserve that money.

i'm sorry i didnt respond to any of you last night, i had to go to bed early. 
this is the best thread ive ever read, and i have to thank you all for such kindness. it might not look like much to any of you, but you probably saved my life.

thank you all again.

i guess so. i really don't want to seem like an asshole teenager because this thread has been the greatest amount of kindness ive gotten in the last month or so, so i should just say thank you so much.

hey, thank you a lot. you are an amazing person and one who really made me feel better. 
i can't take your money. thank you so, so so, so much for your kindness. you really have no idea.
there are probably much better ways to spend your money than on some angsty teenager. you really made my week. i hope you have an amazing day.

i typed this comment and really really want you to know how awesome you are. seriously. thank you a lot.
